news.headline: 35th AGM: FY26 financial statements adopted; Dinesh P. Jain re-appointed as director with 99.98% votes
Abakkus Small Cap Fund raised stake 52.95% MoM to 0.66% (Rs 17.34 cr); no MF exits on record
Retail head Dhyanesh Kumar retired; Ajay Thotlani appointed Brand Head (Integriti) as senior managerial personnel
Q1 FY27 concall transcript filed: 19% revenue growth, 19%+ EBITDA margins driven by volume growth and brand positioning
Q1 FY27: revenue Rs 279 cr (+19% YoY), EBITDA Rs 54 cr (+29%), PAT Rs 41 cr (+29%); FY26 revenue Rs 1,213 cr, PAT Rs 153 cr
